spans.s: कश m. (used in the plural) A whip, निःशंकं कर्कशाः कशाः । तव गात्रे पतिष्यंति सहास्माकं मनोरथैः Mrich.ix.
कशा f. 1. A whip; 2. flogging; 3. a string, a rope.
कष (I) a. (f. षा) Rubbing.
कष (II) m. 1. Rubbing; 2. a touchstone, छदहेम कषन्निवालसत्कषयाषाणनिभे नभस्तले Na.ii.69.
कष (I) a. (f. षा) Rubbing.
कषा f. The same as कशा q.v.
काश(स) (I) m.n. A species of grass used for mats, roofs &c., Rt.iii.1, 26.
काश(स) (II) n. A flower of that grass, K.S.vii.11, R.iv.17.
काश(स) (III) m. 1. Cough, catarrh, काशाश्रुलालाविलः Sant.S.ii.29; 2. sneezing.
काश(स) (I) m.n. A species of grass used for mats, roofs &c., Rt.iii.1, 26.
काश(स) (II) n. A flower of that grass, K.S.vii.11, R.iv.17.
काश(स) (III) m. 1. Cough, catarrh, काशाश्रुलालाविलः Sant.S.ii.29; 2. sneezing.
कास m. Cough, catarrh.
काष m. 1. Rubbing, पथिषु विटपिनां स्कंदधकाषैः सधूमः Ve.ii.; 2. that against which anything is rubbed, लीनालिः सुरकरिणां कपोलकाषः Kir.v.26, (काषः कषणस्थानं द्रुमस्कंधादि Mall.).
कासा f. Cough, catarrh.
कशिपु (I) m.n. 1. A mat; 2. bed.
कशिपु (II) m. 1. Food; 2. clothing; (according to विश्व, however, it means ‘food and clothing’ together.)
कशे(से)रु m.n. 1. The back bone; 2. a kind of grass.
कशे(से)रु m.n. 1. The back bone; 2. a kind of grass.
कश्मल (I) a. (f. ला) Foul, dishonourable, discreditable, मत्संबंधात्मकश्मला किंवदंती Ut.i.
कश्मल (II) n. 1. Sin; 2. a swoon; 3. dejection of mind, depression of spirits, कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् Bg.ii.2.
कश्मल (I) a. (f. ला) Foul, dishonourable, discreditable, मत्संबंधात्मकश्मला किंवदंती Ut.i.
कश्मीर m. pl. The name of a country, the modern Kāshmīr. (Its position is thus described- शारदामठमारभ्य कुंकुमाद्रितटांतकः । तावत्कश्मीरदेशः स्यात् पंचाशद्योजनात्मकः.)
काश्मीर (I) a. (f. री) Born in or coming from Kāśmīra.
काश्मीर (II) m. pl. The name of a country or its inhabitants.
काश्मीर (III) n. 1. Saffron, पद्मापयोधरतटीपरिरंभलग्नकाश्मीरमुद्रितमुरो मधुसूदनस्य Git.G.i., Ch.
; 2. root of a tree.
कश्मीर-ज, -जन्मन् m.n. saffron, e.g. कश्मीरजस्य कटुताऽपि नितांतरम्या.
काश्मीर-ज, -जन्मन् n. saffron, Bh.V.i.71.
कश्मीर-ज, -जन्मन् m.n. saffron, e.g. कश्मीरजस्य कटुताऽपि नितांतरम्या.
काश्मीर-ज, -जन्मन् n. saffron, Bh.V.i.71.
कश्य (I) a. (f. श्या) Fit to be whipped.
कश्य (II) n. Spirituous liquor.
कश्य (I) a. (f. श्या) Fit to be whipped.
काश्य n. Spirituous liquor.
कश्यप m. 1. A tortoise; 2. name of a Ṛshi, the husband of Aditi and Diti and the father of gods and demons.
काश्य-प n. flesh.
काश्यप m. 1. Name of a celebrated sage; 2. a name of Kaṇāda.
कष् vt. 1P (pp. कषित) 1. To rub with a touch-stone, to test, छदहेम कषन्निवालसत्कषयाषाणनिभे नभस्तले Na.ii.69; 2. to rub, to scrape, Bt.iii.49; 3. to injure, to destroy.

कस् (I) vt. 1P (pp. कसित) 1. To go, to approach.With वि-, to open, to expand, विकसति हि पतंगस्योदये पुंडरीकम् M.M.i., Sis.ix.47, K.S.vii.55; (caus. pres. कासयति-ते).With निस्-, 1. to take out; 2. to drive out or away, to banish, to expel, निरकासयद्रविमपेतवसुं वियदालयादपरदिग्गणिका Sis.ix.10.With प्र-, to open, to cause to expand, घनमुक्तांबुलवप्रकाशितैः (कुसुमैः)
Ghat.19
.With वि-, to open, to cause to expand, इंदुर्विकासयति कैरविणीकुलानि Bhartr.ii.
कस् (II) vt. 2Ā (pres. कस्ते or कंस्ते) 1. To go; 2. to destroy.

काश् (I) vi. 1Ā (pp. काशित) 1. To be visible, नैवं भूमिर्न च दिशः प्रदिशो वा चकाशिरे Bh.iii.; 2. to shine, to look brilliant or beautiful, R.x.86, vii.24, K.S.i.24, Bt.ii.25; (hence) 3. to appear or look like.With प्र-, 1. to be visible; 2. to shine, to look brilliant; (hence) 3. to appear or look like.With प्रति-, 1. to appear like; 2. to shine in opposition.With वि-, 1. to open up as a flower; 2. to shine.With सम्-, to appear like.

काश् (Caus. काशयति-ते) With निस्-, 1. to open; 2. to take out, to present to the sight; 3. to turn out, to banish, e.g. गृहान्निष्काशयेत्.With प्र-, 1. to show, to discover, to disclose, to reveal, अवसरोऽयमानात्मानं प्रकाशयितुम् Sak.i.; 2. to lighten, to illumine, यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः Bg.xiii.33; 3. to bring to light, to make public, to communicate, to proclaim, कदाचित्कुपितं मित्रं सर्वदोषं प्रकाशयेत् Cāṇakya.
काश् (II) vi. 4Ā (pp. काशित) 1. To shine, to appear like; 2. to be visible.
कास् vi. 1Ā (pp. कासित) To cough, to make a sound indicating any disease.
कषण n. 1. Rubbing, marking, कषणकंपनिरस्तमहाहिभिः Kir.v.47; 2. test of gold by the touchstone.
कषाय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Astringent; 2. fragrant, स्फुटितकमलामोदमैत्रीकषायः Megh.i.31; 3. red, dark-red, चूतांकुरास्वादकषायकंठः K.S.iii.32; 4. brown; 5. improper, dirty.

कषाय (II) m.n. 1. Astringent flavour; 2. the red colour; 3. a decoction which has one part of a drug with 8 or 16 parts of water, the whole being boiled down until one quarter is left, M.xi.153; 4. gum, resin, extract; 5. plastering, anointing; 6. perfuming the person, Rt.i.4; 7. dirt, uncleanliness; 8. attachment to worldly objects.
कषाय (III) m. 1. Passion, emotion; 2. the Kaliyuga.
कषाय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Astringent; 2. fragrant, स्फुटितकमलामोदमैत्रीकषायः Megh.i.31; 3. red, dark-red, चूतांकुरास्वादकषायकंठः K.S.iii.32; 4. brown; 5. improper, dirty.
काषाय a. (f. यी) Red, dyed of a reddish colour, काषायवसनो याति कुंकुमालेपनो यतिः R.G.
कषायित a. (f. ता) Tinged, coloured, अमुनैव कषायितस्तनी K.S.iv.34.
कषायित a. (f. ता) Tinged, coloured, अमुनैव कषायितस्तनी K.S.iv.34.
कषि a. Injurious, mischievous.
काशि (I) m. pl. The name of a country.
काशि (II) f. Name of a celebrated city on the Ganges, the modern Benares. It is one of the seven sacred cities. See कांची.
काशी f. See काशि II.
कषे(से)रुका f. The backbone, the spine.
कषे(से)रुका f. The backbone, the spine.

कष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Bad, evil, wrong, कष्टात्कष्टतरं गता R.xv.43, ‘gone from bad to worse’; 2. painful, grievous, मोहादभूत्कष्टतरः प्रबोधः R.xiv.56, or कष्टा वृत्तिः पराधीना कष्टो वासो निराश्रयः Cāṇakya.; 3. difficult, स्त्रीषु कष्टोऽधिकारः Vikr.iii., Yaj.iii.29; 4. difficult to subdue (as an enemy), M.vii.186, 210; 5. mischievous, injurious.

कष्ट (II) n. 1. Evil, difficulty, misery, suffering, uneasiness, अर्थार्थी याति कष्टानि Panch.ii.; 2. sin.(कष्टम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘alas,’ कष्टं युद्धे दश शेषाः श्रुता मे त्रयोऽस्माकं पांडवानां च सप्त Bh.

कष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Bad, evil, wrong, कष्टात्कष्टतरं गता R.xv.43, ‘gone from bad to worse’; 2. painful, grievous, मोहादभूत्कष्टतरः प्रबोधः R.xiv.56, or कष्टा वृत्तिः पराधीना कष्टो वासो निराश्रयः Cāṇakya.; 3. difficult, स्त्रीषु कष्टोऽधिकारः Vikr.iii., Yaj.iii.29; 4. difficult to subdue (as an enemy), M.vii.186, 210; 5. mischievous, injurious.
कष्ट-आगत a. arrived or obtained with difficulty.
कष्ट-कर a. giving pain or trouble.
कष्ट-तपस् a. one who performs hard penance.
कष्ट-साध्य a. accomplishable with difficulty.
कष्ट-स्थान n. a bad station, a difficult place.
कष्टि f. 1. Test, trial; 2. pain, trouble.
कस्तुरिका f. Musk, Bh.V.vi.121, ii.4, Sr.
, Ch.
कस्तुरिका f. Musk, Bh.V.vi.121, ii.4, Sr.
, Ch.
कस्तुरिका f. Musk, Bh.V.vi.121, ii.4, Sr.
, Ch.
कस्तुरिका-मृग m. the musk-deer.
कस्तुरिका-मृग m. the musk-deer.
कस्तुरिका-मृग m. the musk-deer.
काशि-प m. an epithet of Śiva.
काशिन् a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of compounds) Shining, appearing like, having the semblance of, e.g. जितकाशिन् ‘one who deports himself like a conqueror,’ जितकाशी राजसेवकः Mud.ii.
काशिन् a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of compounds) Shining, appearing like, having the semblance of, e.g. जितकाशिन् ‘one who deports himself like a conqueror,’ जितकाशी राजसेवकः Mud.ii.
काशी-नाथ m. an epithet of Śiva.
काशी-यात्रा f. pilgrimage to Benares.
काश्मरी f. A plant commonly called गांभरी, काश्मर्याः कृतमालमुद्गतदलं कोयष्टिकष्टीकत M.M.ix.
काश्मीर (I) a. (f. री) Born in or coming from Kāśmīra.
काश्यप-नंदन m. 1. an epithet of Garuḍa; 2. of Aruṇa.
काश्यपि m. 1. An epithet of Garuḍa; 2. of Aruṇa.
काश्यपी f. The earth, काश्यपी यातस्तवापि च विवेकः Bh.V.i.68.
काषाय a. (f. यी) Red, dyed of a reddish colour, काषायवसनो याति कुंकुमालेपनो यतिः R.G.
काष्ठ n. 1. A piece of wood, especially one used as fuel, M.iv.241; 2. wood or timber in general, M.iv.49; 3. a stick, Yaj.ii.218; 4. an instrument for measuring length.

काष्ठा f. 1. The path of wind and clouds; 2. a quarter or region of the world (दिश्); 3. a limit, a bound, परा हि काष्ठा तपसः K.S.v.28; 4. the last limit, extremity, excess, काष्ठागतस्नेहरसानुविद्धम् K.S.iii.35; 5. a measure of time equal to the thirtieth part of a Kalā.
काष्ठ-अगार m.n. a wooden house or enclosure.
काष्ठ-अंबुवाहिनी f. a wooden bucket.
काष्ठ-कदली f. the wild plantain.
काष्ठ-कीट m. a small insect found in decayed wood.
काष्ठ-कुट्ट m. a worm generally found in wood.
काष्ठ-कुद्दाल m. a kind of wooden shovel used for baling water out of a boat for cleaning its bottom.
काष्ठ-तक्ष, -तक्षक m. carpenter.
काष्ठ-तक्ष, -तक्षक m. carpenter.
काष्ठ-तंतु m. a small worm found in timber.
काष्ठ-दारु m. the Indian pine tree otherwise called देवदारु.
काष्ठ-द्रु m. the Palāśa tree.
काष्ठ-पुत्तलिका f. a wooden image.
काष्ठ-भारिक m. a wood-carrier.
काष्ठ-मठी f. a funeral pile.
काष्ठ-मय a. 1. wooden, M.ii.157; 2. hard-hearted, cruel.
काष्ठ-मल्ल m. a bier, a wooden frame on which dead bodies are carried.
काष्ठ-लेखक m. a small worm found in wood, (the same as काष्ठकुट्ट).
काष्ठ-लोहिन् m. a cudgel armed with iron.
काष्ठ-वाट m.n. a wall made of wood.
काष्ठक n. Aloe-wood.
काष्ठिक m. A bearer of wood.
काष्ठिका f. A small piece of wood.
काष्ठील f. The plantain tree.
कास-कुंठ a. afflicted with cough.
कासर m. (fem. ˚री) Buffalo.
कासार m.n. A pond, a pool, Bh.V.i.43.
कासू(शू) f. 1. A sort of lance; 2. indistinct speech; 3. light, lustre.
कासू(शू) f. 1. A sort of lance; 2. indistinct speech; 3. light, lustre.
कासृति f. A by-way, a secret path.
